title: Yummy Greek Paired with Pastry
description: A charred and crisp Greek dish featuring parma ham, finished with an al-dente finish. Ideal for a halal-friendly meal.
instructions: Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a spoonful of feta cheese in the center of each dough circle.
Add a few cherry tomato halves and a sprinkle of parsley on top of the cheese.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together with a fork.
Brush the tops of the pastry with a little water and sprinkle with salt.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the pastry is baking, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced parma ham and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until crispy.
Remove the pastry from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the charred parma ham on top of the pastry, with a dollop of feta cheese on the side.
